name: JUDGE
label: Month 3 · Generation evals, then PAUSE
goal: One self-contained week on LLM-as-judge and tracing, then a clean 3-week park.

weeks.title: Generation evals + tracing (self-contained before the pause)
weeks.why: Retrieval evals answer 'did we find it'. Generation evals answer 'did we use it honestly'. This week is deliberately built as a closed unit — you will pause for three weeks after it, so it ends with nothing half-finished.

tasks.t: Faithfulness / groundedness — is every claim supported by a retrieved chunk? This is how you measure hallucination.
Answer relevance and context precision. Know the difference between 'wrong answer' and 'right answer, wrong reason'.
LLM-as-judge: write a rubric, use a stronger model as judge, and beware position bias and self-preference bias
CALIBRATE the judge: label 30 examples yourself, measure judge-vs-you agreement. An uncalibrated judge is a random number generator.
Set up Langfuse (free tier or self-host) or Arize Phoenix (fully OSS). Trace one full RAG request end to end.
PAUSE PREP: write a handover note to your future self — what you were doing, what is broken, what is next, how to restart the stack in one command

resources.label: Eugene Yan — LLM evaluators (judges), biases and how to calibrate
Langfuse — open-source LLM observability, generous free tier
Arize Phoenix — fully open-source tracing and evals

weeks.deliverable: An end-to-end traced RAG pipeline + a calibrated LLM judge with a measured agreement rate against your own labels. Plus a handover note.
weeks.checkpoint: Your judge scores your system 4.6/5. Why is that number meaningless on its own, and what makes it meaningful?

weeks.title: PARKED — week 1 of 3
weeks.why: Planned disruption. This is scheduled, not a failure. The roadmap accounts for it; do not try to 'catch up' by cramming, and do not feel behind. Your Week 9 handover note is waiting.

tasks.t: OPTIONAL, ZERO PRESSURE: if you get a spare hour, watch something passive. No laptop required.

resources.label: 3Blue1Brown — Neural networks series (pure watching, no setup)

weeks.title: PARKED — week 2 of 3
weeks.why: Still parked. Protect the pause — half-studying during a disruption produces guilt without learning.

tasks.t: OPTIONAL: podcasts or talks while commuting. Latent Space, or any conference talk on LLM evals.

resources.label: Latent Space — the AI engineer podcast/newsletter (free)

weeks.title: PARKED — week 3 of 3 · re-entry ramp
weeks.why: Last parked week. In the final 2 days, do one 30-minute action only: open the repo and run the test suite. Nothing else. The goal is to remove the activation energy for Week 13.

tasks.t: Last 2 days only: git pull, docker compose up, run eval.py once. Confirm it still runs. Stop there.

weeks.deliverable: A green test run. That is all.
